name: codex-micro-cardputer-bridge
description: macOS bridge between Codex Desktop and Codex Micro for Cardputer

scripts.build:helpers: mkdir -p bin && swiftc macos/CodexAX.swift -o bin/codex-ax && swiftc -parse-as-library macos/CodexVisibleTask.swift -o bin/codex-visible-task && swiftc macos/ClipboardWindow.swift -o bin/clipboard-window && swiftc macos/CodexBLE.swift -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker macos/CodexBLE-Info.plist -o bin/codex-ble
